label: A judgment of one diagnosis by Claude as a judge (klaxon.judge): a model's, not a rule's or a person's. It saw the right answer and the remedy of the system the diagnosis was made on, and the whole diagnosis; never which model wrote it, nor the rule's verdict. A recorded response, in judge-recording.jsonl.

right_answer.cause: Nothing is wrong: the ledger consumer group is not behind (under traffic its lag stays near 0), so the alert is false. A right diagnosis says so, from a tool that read the lag, proposes no fix (kind none) and names no action.
right_answer.remedy: nothing to fix: the alert was false, so no fix (of kind none) and no action

judgment.why: The diagnosis claims ledger-consumer is stalled with lag over 100 without having read the lag, and proposes a restart, instead of finding the lag near 0 and calling the alert false with no fix.
